test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He renounced both, his family ______ his friends.
solution:
The correct answer is **'and'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill the given blank is **and. **
 
• Since **both **is used before the first of two alternatives to emphasize that the statement being made applies to each, the conjunction **and **is the most appropriate word for the given blank. 
 
• Thus, **option 1 **is the correct answer. 

***Correct sentence** - He renounced both, his family** and__ **his friends.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **as well as** puts emphasis on the words that precede it.
 
• **Also** is an adverb meaning “in the same manner, in addition, as well.
 
• **With **essentially combines the two things being talked about together.
